title: Genus-zero-or-one structure of spaces with product dimension twice their dimension
author: Christine Bachoc; Alain Couvreur; Gilles Zémor
work: Towards a function field version of Freiman's Theorem
difficulty_reason: After standard valuations, Riemann--Roch and Freiman's additive theorem, the authored proof still controls the unique weight-two index in a lattice of product subspaces and transfers valuation information into divisor increments through a new separation lemma. It derives a cubic relation from two independent relations in S_3S_4, handles both possible P-index regimes, and determines the complete divisor chain to obtain the genus-zero codimension-one or genus-one Riemann--Roch description. These source-local lattice, elimination and divisor arguments go substantially beyond routine doctoral qualifying-exam algebraic-curve exercises.

contexts.scope: Complete authored body including all new local proof core; later results uncounted context
